dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: (Aaagh! My beak... won't move... at all! Ow, ow, ow...)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Your beak's been injured. Give me a moment, I'll take care of it...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Fortunately, it was just the tip... What did you peck at, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: (Over there, among the soft flowers, there's some tough, pretty ones too! I wanted to pick one and bring it home!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: At the Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse, you mean? I believe that a portion of the flowers they sell are made of metal... I see. No wonder.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Alright, child. Don't just peck at anything you see. I'll purchase one for you. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: (Thanks! The flower, so pretty! I'll bring it home, and home will be pretty too!)
